level_route.scale: Each stage substantially larger than current six-region eleven-enemy prototype. Aim16–20 distinguishable rooms/regions, two or three arenas,32–44 enemies and 400–600m main travel including key returns. Human pacing subject to playtest; no bot time presented as human duration.
level_route.extras: Minimum4 optional side rooms,2 secrets and2 shortcuts per stage; secrets bonus only. Main supplies enough to finish without secrets. At least one physical stair/height change and working lift. Colour/icon/label connections on gate/button/key, brief current objective and visited-only map. Clear spatial main route without wall labels becoming tutorials.
level_route.geometry: Room footprints and connecting portals authored explicitly; every open portal has contiguous visible/physical floor. Closed/moving/open doors block movement, ray visibility/hitscan/projectiles consistently. Fixed physics; no arbitrary timer locks. No invisible collision ramps; visible mesh and collider same.
level_route.arena_contract: Spawns carry arena_id. Activation wakes that group. Enemy-death events only advance authored group state once; no unvisited secret kill needed. A clear arena ENABLES its marked physical button, rather than automatically granting key. Do not trap on closing doors crushing player; initially locked onward gate, retreat route remains available.

gore_contract.design: More forceful directional blood fans and wall/floor spatter, legible anatomical severed pieces with momentum/tumbling/settling, species-aware flesh/metal fragments, varied death results tied to weapon/contact/overkill. Shoot intact dead bodies to break them further without extra kills or live damage; once fully gibbed cannot repeat burst endlessly. Existing dry contact/vocals/music preserved.
gore_contract.ownership: Single accepted shot owns damage/impact/gore. Corpse query layer8 exclusively cosmetic; no actor movement or projectile targeting, no dead attacks. Collision mask include corpses only for weapon anatomical ray queries; world still blocks first. Deduplicate same shotgun/target. Corpses have bounded cosmetic integrity and transition once; event corpse_hurt/corpse_gib separate from enemy_death; deaths/kills unchanged.
gore_contract.limits: Per-stage budgets sized for44enemy corpses; deterministic fixed physics; pause freezes; retry resets bodies/fragments/stains/query colliders. Surface-conforming patches respect actual slopes/stairs/walls. Preserve prior fixtures but update expectations when counts intentionally change.
